Positive argument beyond a bare universal assertion: co. [59435] starts from effect-dependence on its cause. Loss of an essential material/formal principle destroys its constituted thing; efficient dependence is then indexed to the form's dependence on that agent, rather than every producer being needed forever. A univocal generating fire and generated fire have the same specific form/grade and differ materially, so the generator is not per se cause of that form according to its specific character. Aquinas infers a higher per-se cause of the form. He adds that bodily agents act only through motion, while a form's being in matter does not of itself imply motion; hence its per-se source is incorporeal, with bodily generation an instrumental actualization of suitably disposed matter. The generated thing can remain after its bodily generator ceases: what ceases is production, not the already acquired form. Dependence on the incorporeal cause is instead asserted to concern esse itself; removal of that action removes the created effect's being. This is an articulated causal-role argument, not the inference that whatever began once needs its original generator now.

Exact retained burdens: [59435] explicitly identifies the incorporeal creator of ALL bodily and incorporeal things, forms AND matter, with God by reference to a result shown in another question. That prior universal creation/source claim is imported, not independently established here; neither that other question nor a source-identity proof has been read in this task. The article also retains the effect-dependence principle, the inference from a caused same-species form to a higher per-se source of its specific character, the bodily-action-through-motion restriction, and the application of ongoing action-dependence to esse. These substantive premises must be defended against an account on which the acquired form/intrinsic principles and absence of destructive change suffice. Merely sharing a species does not by itself prove that one common numerical sustaining source exists. A proposed primitive underived whole essence is not shown here to belong to the already-created domain merely by calling it a being. The article does not replace those burdens with participation terminology: its own distinctive rationale is form/agent and per-se/per-accidens dependence, followed by the imported universal creator identification.

Strong rival and replies: arg.4–7 [59416–59419] explicitly raise persistence after efficient production, form-caused existence and the claim that an effect with completed being can persist independently; arg.10–11 [59422–59423] propose form and matter as sufficient principles; arg.14 [59426] tests collective creature self-sufficiency. Replies ad3–5 [59438–59440] preserve completed-generation persistence while locating form/matter themselves within divine dependence; ad10 [59445] says the form too would cease, which depends on the body's higher-source account rather than independently refuting intrinsic persistence. Ad6 [59441] expressly distinguishes fully realized forms that remain until corruption, heat that remains temporarily and illumination as an imperfect intentional likeness requiring its source. Thus the illumination illustration supports a restricted source-dependent state; it is not an independently observed case of bare substantial-bearer conservation. Ad7 [59442] limits bodily conserving action to retaining suitable material dispositions, with historical celestial-motion assumptions explicit. Ad11 [59446] distinguishes not generated from not caused; ad14 [59449] denies that best within creatures means absolutely unsurpassable.

Rejected readings: ad2 [59437] makes production and conservation the SAME divine operation, not repeated annihilation/re-creation or successive additions to an incomplete thing. Ad8 [59443] does not make nothing an active corruptor: cessation follows absence of the conserving action. Ad16 [59451] rejects treating tending to nothing as a natural motion. Neither the article's instant language nor ongoing esse-dependence identifies model-world existence with being alive now; F has no time parameter. The actual-world/direct-ground interface remains distinct from a universal law asserting a conserver for every individual. A historical producer is not automatically an esse-conserver; efficient cause, formal constitution, explanatory reason and the selected grounds relation remain distinct dictionaries.

Conclusion/premise comparison: the article strengthens the available primary explanation of WHY a per-se cause of esse would be continually required, while explicitly accepting inertia relative to a completed bodily generator. It does not independently establish universal conservation without its higher-source/creation and causal-role assumptions, nor identify every F relation instance or establish F's concrete/world-presence guards. No root premise is discharged; no philosophical truth status changes. The decisive application question is whether the same actual target's acquired form/esse is genuinely the effect of an ongoing per-se cause rather than adequately explained by retained intrinsic principles plus prior existence/no destruction. If that source-role application is independently supplied, the existing conditional conservation and direct-F interfaces remain available without another opaque theorem. Full q.5 a.1 is now READ, not an unread successor; no q.5 a.2 or uninspected cited-work reading is claimed.
